description: Oversvømmelse eller Erosion - PlanDK is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Sections 11a, 18 of the Planning Act ‘Designation of areas that may be subject to flooding or erosion and for the establishment of preventive measures to protect against flooding or erosion when planning urban development, special technical installations, changes in land use, etc. Coverage: Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Flood or Erosion - PlanDK" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Plan- og Landdistriktsstyrelsen. Its keywords include Land Use, Kommunal planlægning. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, GML, PNG. The listing shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
